words.zh: n. 博客；网络随笔；日志；  v. 写博客
words.example: She writes a blog about healthy cooking for teenagers.

words.zh: n. 博文；博客帖子
words.example: Her latest blog post explains how to protect personal information online.

words.zh: n. 写博客的人，博主
words.example: The young blogger shared useful tips on using the Internet safely.

words.zh: v. 给……装引擎；  n. 引擎；发动机；火车头；【化】催化，驱动
words.example: The car engine stopped suddenly in the middle of the road.

words.zh: n. 搜索引擎
words.example: Please use a reliable search engine to find information for your project.

words.zh: v. 闲谈，聊天；  n. 闲谈，聊天；【计】聊天
words.example: We often chat online about our homework and school life.

words.zh: n. 小河，溪；流；一股，一串；潮流；光线；数据流，指令流；【计】流；  v. 流（媒体）播放；流出；流动；照射；鱼贯而行；涌动
words.example: Many students stream movies and music on their computers at home.

words.zh: n. 身份；特性；一致；认同；【财】身份；【计】标识
words.example: To protect your identity, never share your password with anyone.

words.zh: phr. 身份证
words.example: You must show your identity card before entering the computer lab.

words.zh: adj. 方便的，省事的；附近的；容易得到的
words.example: The online library is convenient for students who live far away.

words.zh: n. 现金；  v. 兑现；付（或收）现款
words.example: I need to cash this check at the bank before the trip.

words.zh: vt. 更新；为……提供最新信息（读作/ʌpˈdeɪt/）；  n. 更新；最新消息（读作/ˈʌpˌdeɪt/）
words.example: Don't forget to update your app to enjoy the latest features.

words.zh: n. 数据库；资料库；【财】数据库；【计】数据库
words.example: The school library's database helps students find books quickly.

words.zh: n. 软件；【计】软件
words.example: This new software helps students edit videos for their projects.

words.zh: v. 建立关系网；联播；使联网；  n. 广播网，电视网；网络；人际关系网，联络网；互联网；【计】网络；（路线）网络；【电】网络
words.example: We can network with alumni at the career conference tomorrow.

words.zh: adj. 不能动的；束手无策的；不得不的；卡住的；  v. 刺入，插入；阻塞，塞
words.example: My computer screen got stuck, so I restarted the entire machine.

words.zh: phr. 陪伴某人
words.example: My dog keeps me company while I study for exams online.

words.zh: n. 海浪，拍岸浪；  v. 进行冲浪运动，在……上冲浪；网上冲浪，浏览；上网
words.example: I usually surf the Internet for science news after class.

words.zh: v. 得益于；使......受益；  n. 好处；（雇主为员工提供的）福利政策；慈善活动；（政府）补助金，救济金；【法】利益
words.example: Many students benefit from free online learning resources.

words.zh: v. 使与……保持距离，撇清和……的关系；  n. 距离；间距；远处；【化】距离：间距，距离；【物】距离；【数】距离；  adj. 远距离的
words.example: The app allows users to distance themselves from online distractions.

words.zh: v. 激励，鼓舞；激发灵感；启示
words.example: Her success story inspires me to work harder in coding class.

words.zh: phr. 既然；由于
words.example: Now that the Wi-Fi is working, we can start our online research.

words.zh: n. 进入；使用权；通道；（使用或见到的）机会，权利；接触；访问；接近；  v. 进入，使用，获取；（计算机）访问；接近；接触；访问；【计】访问
words.example: Students need a password to access the school's online learning platform.

words.zh: n. 慈善机构（或组织）；慈善；仁慈；施舍；慈善机构
words.example: The online charity event raised money for the local animal shelter.

words.zh: phr. 浏览，查阅；通过，完成；经历；度过；通读；穿过；检查
words.example: Before submitting the essay, please go through the checklist carefully.

words.zh: v. 坚持，忍受；  n. 暴徒，恶棍；  adj. 坚韧的；健壮的；粗野的；嚼不动的；棘手的；艰难的；严厉的；固执的；困难的，难办的；  adv. 强硬地，顽强地
words.example: It can be tough to ignore false information on social media.

words.zh: n. 省；领域，部门
words.example: Our province built new Internet towers in rural villages last year.

words.zh: n. 会议；讨论会；正式会谈
words.example: The science conference will be broadcast live over the Internet.

words.zh: n. 居民；住客；住院实习医师；  adj. 居住的；住校的；固有的；常驻的
words.example: Every resident in the community now has access to high-speed Internet.

words.zh: n. 加号；有利因素；【数】加，加法；  adj. 正的；有利的；阳性的；多的；（分数后）加，略高；  conj. 此外，而且，况且；  prep. 加，加上
words.example: Having a reliable Internet connection is a plus for online learners.

words.zh: v. 起作用；工作，运转；  n. 功能，作用，用途，机能；函数；随他物变化而变化的事物 ；盛大聚会；职务，职责；【计】函数；【化】功能，作用；【电】函数；【数】函数
words.example: The search function on this website works much faster than before.

words.zh: n. 电池（组）；排炮；一组，许多，众多；炮兵连；【化】电池，蓄电池；【物】电池
words.example: My phone battery died because I left the Wi-Fi on all night.

words.zh: v. 确认，使确信；证实；批准
words.example: Please confirm your email address to activate your new account.

words.zh: n. 无线网络
words.example: The library offers free Wi-Fi to all students and teachers.

words.zh: v. 按，压；逼迫；敦促；揿；服役；征用；  n. 出版社；新闻界；压力；强迫；服役；（报刊、广播、电视的）新闻报道；印刷；印刷机
words.example: Press the button on the router to restart your Internet connection.

words.zh: n. 纽扣；按钮，开关；像纽扣的东西；未成熟的蘑菇；  v. 扣紧；扣上纽扣；闭嘴
words.example: Click the blue button to download the file to your computer.

words.zh: n. 文件；文件夹；档案，卷宗；锉刀；纵列，单列；公文箱；【计】文件；  v. 把……归档；提起（诉讼），提出（申请）；锉；列队行进；提交
words.example: Remember to save your file before closing the document editor.

words.zh: phr. 处于良好状态
words.example: Regular online workouts help me stay in shape during the holidays.

words.zh: phr. 记录；跟上...的进展；追踪
words.example: A password manager helps you keep track of all your online accounts.

words.zh: v. 打折（读作/dɪsˈkaʊnt/）；认为……不重要，低估；【数】折现；  n. 折扣（读作/ˈdɪskaʊnt/）；（价格、债款等的）折扣
words.example: Students can get a discount on software with their school email.

words.zh: n. 账目，账户；原因，理由；描述；叙述；解释；报告；估计；利益，好处；价值，重要性；【法】账户，账目；  v. 做出说明（或解释）；把……视作；认为；报账；归咎（于）；占（一定数量或比例）
words.example: You need an account to view the full online course materials.

words.zh: v. 点击(鼠标)；（使）发出咔嗒声；情投意合；博得喝彩；点击；  n. 点击；咔嗒声
words.example: Click the link below to join the video conference meeting.

words.zh: n. 隐私；秘密；私生活
words.example: Think carefully about your privacy before posting personal photos online.

words.zh: n. 偷盗，盗窃；盗窃罪
words.example: The website added extra security to prevent identity theft.

words.zh: adj. 粗鲁的，无礼的；猛烈的，狂暴的
words.example: It is rude to send angry messages in a class group chat.

words.zh: v. 瞄准；把……作为攻击目标；  vt. 面向，把…对准（某群体）；  n. 靶子；目标；对象；指标；【计】目标
words.example: Online ads often target users based on their search history.

words.zh: v. 反复；轮唱(歌曲)；用曳绳钓；搜索，搜查；滚动；  n. 巨怪；钓绳；钓饵；发挑衅帖子的人；恶意挑衅的帖子；巨魔、侏儒等怪物；演子
words.example: A troll posted false comments in the forum, and everyone reported him.

words.zh: n. 网络霸凌；  v. 网络欺凌
words.example: Never become a cyberbully by sending hurtful messages to classmates.

words.zh: adj. 错误的；假的；虚伪的
words.example: Don't share false news before checking the facts from reliable sources.

words.zh: adj. 特别的，不寻常的；特定的；特指的；格外的；挑剔的，讲究的；  n. 细节；详细资料；尤其，特别
words.example: This particular website requires users to create a strong password.

words.zh: adj. 使人尴尬的；令人为难的
words.example: Telling a lie online can lead to an embarrassing situation at school.

words.zh: phr. 嘲笑，取笑，拿......开玩笑
words.example: It is unkind to make fun of someone for their accent online.

words.zh: adj. 苦恼的，沮丧的，心烦的；不适的；弄翻的；混乱的；  v. 使苦恼；颠覆；搅乱；  n. 混乱，推翻；心烦意乱，失望，苦恼
words.example: She felt upset when her social media post received no likes.

words.zh: n. 指导路线；准则；【财】指导方针
words.example: The school guideline says we should protect our personal information online.

words.zh: n. 作者，作家；发起人；  v. 成为作家
words.example: The author of that blog post shares useful tips about Internet safety.

words.zh: v. 轻击；倾斜；给小费；翻倒；  n. 尖端；小费；诀窍，建议；实用的提示；（比赛的）内部消息；指示，指点；提示，技巧，建议
words.example: Can you give me a tip on how to create a strong password?

words.zh: adj. 熟悉的；熟知的；不拘礼节的；亲密的；随便的；  n. 密友；常客；高级官吏的家属
words.example: I am familiar with the basic rules of online communication.

words.zh: phr. 牢记
words.example: Always keep the risks of online chatting in mind.

words.zh: v. 给（词、短语等）下定义；使明确；规定；界定，解释；【计】定义；【化】解释……的含义
words.example: The teacher asked us to define the word privacy in our own words.

words.zh: n. 箱，盒；容器；套；案件；情况；事例，实例；状况，场合；病例，案例；事实；【计】用例，分支；  v. 踩点
words.example: This case shows how quickly private information can spread online.
